description: Split a time range into minute, hour, day, week, month, quarter or year buckets with exact start and end times in a time zone. DST-aware (23- and 25-hour days, repeated and skipped hours), ISO or Sunday/Saturday weeks, fiscal quarters, partial first and last buckets flagged or clipped. Up to 1,000 buckets (500 for weeks and longer). Use for chart axes, time-series grouping and filling empty periods in dashboards. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

clip.description: Clip the first and last buckets to [from, to) instead of returning whole buckets flagged partial

fiscal_year_start.description: Month the fiscal year starts (1 = January). Quarters, halves and years follow it; fiscal years are named by the calendar year they end in (start 7: FY2027 = July 2026 – June 2027)

from.description: Range start: YYYY-MM-DD (local midnight), local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM, or ISO 8601 with offset. Years 1000–9999

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York (default UTC)

week_start.description: First day of the week. monday = ISO weeks (labels like 2026-W46)

name: time_buckets

hours.description: Real length: 23 or 25 on clock-change days

title: Time buckets for charts
